lead_editorial.title: Naxalwaad ke 'ant' ka jashn theek, par asli imtihaan ab shuru hota hai — bandook ke baad vikas aur bharosa
lead_editorial.summary: Sarkar is baar Rashtriya Ekta Diwas ko hathiyaarband Naxalwaad ke khaatme ke utsav ke roop mein mana rahi hai. Suraksha balon ki kaamyaabi badi hai, lekin un 126 zilon mein sthaayi shanti tabhi aayegi jab sadak, school, rozgaar aur nyay wahan tak pahunchein.
body: Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan ke mutabik aaj Ekta Nagar mein hone waali Ekta Parade ka kendra 2026 mein hathiyaarband Naxalwaad ke unmoolan ki ladaai hogi. Jin rajya police aur kendriya balon ne yeh abhiyaan chalaaya, woh Pradhan Mantri ke saamne march karenge, aur Naxal prabhavit rahe 126 zilon ke kareeb 2,000 kalakaar National School of Drama ki prastuti mein hissa lenge. Yeh kisi bhi sarkar ke liye garv ka pal hai, aur un jawaanon ke liye bhi jinhone dashkon tak is ladaai ki keemat chukaayi.

Lekin itihaas sikhaata hai ki ugrawaad ki jadein aksar bandook se zyada gehri hoti hain — zameen, jungle par haq, visthaapan aur sarkaari mashinari ki gair-maujoodgi mein. Agar suraksha bal peechhe hatne ke baad wahan sirf khaali jagah bachi, to purane zakhm phir khul sakte hain. Isliye 'ant' ka elaan ek padaav hai, manzil nahi.

Hamari raay mein ab sarkar ko utni hi tezi se un zilon ke liye ek saaf, samay-baddh vikas khaaka saamne rakhna chahiye: Adivasi samudaayon ke van adhikaar daavon ka nipataara, khanan pariyojnaaon mein sthaaniya logon ki bhaagidaari, aur jinhone hathiyaar daale unke punarvaas ki imaandaar nigraani. Saath hi us daur mein hue nuksaan — chahe suraksha balon ke ho ya aam naagrikon ke — unki jawaabdehi ki prakriya bhi bharose ke liye zaroori hai.

Sardar Patel ki viraasat sirf rajyon ko jodne ki nahi, logon ke man ko jodne ki bhi thi. Ekta Parade ki jhaankiyaan is baar pehli baar aam naagrikon ke design par aadhaarit hain — yeh achha sanket hai. Ab yahi bhaagidaari ki bhaavna Bastar se Gadchiroli tak zameen par dikhni chahiye, tabhi yeh jashn sthaayi saabit hoga.

stories.title: Sardar Patel ki 151vi jayanti par aaj Ekta Nagar mein PM Modi; Ekta Parade ka focus 'hathiyaarband Naxalwaad ka ant', 126 zilon ke 2,000 kalakaar karenge prastuti
stories.summary: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas ke mauke par Pradhan Mantri Statue of Unity par shraddhaanjali denge aur shaam ki Ekta Parade dekhenge, jismein Naxal-virodhi abhiyaan chalaane waale bal march karenge.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi aaj, 31 October ko, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ki 151vi jayanti par Gujarat ke Ekta Nagar (Kevadia) mein Rashtriya Ekta Diwas samaaroh mein shaamil honge. DD India ke mutabik woh Statue of Unity par Sardar Patel ko shraddhaanjali denge aur shaam ko Ekta Parade dekhenge. Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan ne New Delhi mein press conference mein bataaya ki is saal ki parade ka kendra 2026 mein hathiyaarband Naxalwaad ke khilaaf ladaai aur uske unmoolan par hoga.

Jin rajya police balon aur Central Armed Police Forces ne Naxal-virodhi abhiyaan ki aguvaai ki, woh PM ke saamne march past karenge aur har dal ke guzarte waqt LED screen par uski uplabdhiyon par chhoti filmein dikhaayi jaayengi. News On AIR ke mutabik parade mein BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP aur SSB ke saath kai rajyon ki police tukdiyaan hongi. National School of Drama Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay ke upanyaas 'Anandamath' par aadhaarit prastuti dega, jismein Naxal prabhavit rahe 126 zilon ke kareeb 2,000 kalakaar honge; in zilon ke lagbhag 5,000 logon ko darshak ke roop mein bulaaya gaya hai.

Is baar ki theme 'Vande Mataram' hai, jo rashtriya geet ke 150ve varsh ko darshaati hai. Pehli baar Ekta Nagar mein 15 jhaankiyaan mantralayon ke bajaay naagrikon dwara MyGov aur Gujarat ke zila-star muqablon mein bheje gaye design par aadhaarit hongi. Iske alawa kareeb 5,000 kalakaar Gujarat mein base alag-alag rajyon ke samudaayon ki lagbhag 50 saanskritik prastutiyaan denge.

stories.title: INDIA bloc ka CEC Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf 'public impeachment' aaj 2:30 baje; Supreme Court mein ECI bola — UP mein thok mein Form 7 ke aarop jaanch mein galat paaye
stories.summary: Baarish ke kaaran taala gaya Opposition ka pratikaatmak kaaryakram aaj Kharge ke 10 Rajaji Marg awas par hoga; kal Ramlila Maidan mein rally. Udhar SIR maamle Supreme Court mein lambit rahenge.
body: Shukravaar ki baarish ke baad INDIA bloc ne Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf apna 'public impeachment' aaj Shanivaar dopahar 2:30 baje rakha hai. ThePrint (PTI) ki report ke mutabik yeh pratikaatmak kaaryavaahi Congress adhyaksh Mallikarjun Kharge ke 10 Rajaji Marg sthit awas par hogi aur iski adhyakshata purv Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar karengi. TMC, Samajwadi Party, Shiv Sena (UBT), CPI(M), CPI, RJD aur RSP ke neta shaamil honge. Ravivaar 1 November ko Ramlila Maidan mein march aur rally ki yojana hai.

Opposition Chunav Aayog aur CEC par 'vote chori' aur SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ke zariye logon ko matdaata soochi se baahar karne ka aarop laga raha hai — yeh raajnitik aarop hain, koi aupchaarik kanooni charge nahi. Rahul Gandhi ne kaha, "This is not multiple protests. This is one protest." Congress ka kehna hai ki kaaryakram ke liye maangi gayi anumati nahi di gayi.

Isi beech Shukravaar ko Supreme Court mein UP, Kerala aur Chhattisgarh ke SIR maamlon ki sunvaai hui. LiveLaw ki live report ke mutabik ECI ne kaha ki Kerala aur Chhattisgarh mein prakriya poori ho chuki hai, aur UP mein thok mein Form 7 (naam hataane ki arzi) jama karne ke aaropon ki uske adhikaariyon ne jaanch ki aur unhein galat paaya. Court ne kaha ki maamla tab tak lambit rahega jab tak mudde suljhaaye nahi jaate, aur paksh compliance file karenge.

stories.title: Miyapur zameen maamle mein Supreme Court se Telangana sarkar ko jeet; CM Revanth Reddy ka daava — Rs 50,000 crore ki sarkaari zameen bachi, BRS par nishaana
stories.summary: Mukhyamantri ne adhikaariyon ko zameen kabze mein lene ka nirdesh diya aur kaha ki kuch hisse bechkar sinchai, shiksha aur swaasthya par kharch kiya ja sakta hai; antim faisla cabinet karegi.
body: Supreme Court ne Shukravaar ko Hyderabad ke Miyapur ki vivaadit zameen par faisla sunaaya, jise Telangana sarkar ne apni jeet bataaya. ANI ki report ke mutabik Mukhyamantri A Revanth Reddy ne kaha ki is faisle se Miyapur mein lagbhag Rs 50,000 crore keemat ki sarkaari zameen surakshit hui hai aur adhikaariyon ko use kabze mein lene ke nirdesh diye gaye hain. Report mein court ke vistrit tark ka zikr nahi hai.

Reddy ke mutabik sarkar kuch keemti zameen bechkar uski kamaai sinchai, shiksha aur swaasthya par lagaane par vichaar karegi; resource mobilisation par cabinet sub-committee isse jaanchegi aur antim faisla cabinet ka hoga. Unhone daava kiya ki 2023 se ab tak sarkar Rs 1.50 lakh crore ki zameen avaidh kabze se bacha chuki hai.

Mukhyamantri ne faisle ko purv BRS sarkar aur purv CM K Chandrashekhar Rao ke liye 'tamaacha' bataaya aur KCR, unke rishtedaar Damodar Rao aur 'Goldstone' Prasad par zameen par kabze ke aarop lagaaye. Yeh aarop hain aur report mein BRS ya aaropit logon ka jawaab shaamil nahi hai. Reddy ne BRS ko Vidhan Sabha mein is mudde par bahas ki chunauti bhi di.

editorial.title: SIR vivaad: sadak par pradarshan apni jagah, lekin faisla saboot aur court ki kasauti par hoga
body: Aaj ka 'public impeachment' Opposition ka raajnitik sandesh hai, aur loktantra mein aise virodh ki jagah hai. Lekin isi hafte Supreme Court mein ECI ne kaha ki UP mein thok mein Form 7 ke aarop jaanch mein galat nikle. Yeh daava bhi ek paksh ka hai, aur court ne maamla khula rakha hai — yaani abhi kisi ki 'jeet' ka elaan jaldbaazi hogi.

Hamari raay mein dono pakshon ke liye raasta ek hi hai: data. Opposition ko apne aaropon ke saath booth-star ke thos udaaharan rakhne chahiye, aur Chunav Aayog ko hataaye gaye naamon ka kshetra-vaar, kaaran-sahit byora saarvajanik karna chahiye. Matdaata ka bharosa narebaazi se nahi, paardarshita se lautega.

stories.title: Hormuz mein tanaav jaari: Oman ne jalte tanker RITI se 25 crew bachaaye, IRGC ne 'anadhikrit raaste' par do tanker roke; CENTCOM bola — mukhya raaste baaroodi surangon se mukt
stories.summary: Iran ek aur supertanker mein mine visfot ka daava kar raha hai, jabki America ka kehna hai ki mukhya shipping lanes saaf hain. Kisi bhi paksh ke daave ki swatantra pushti nahi hui hai.
body: Oman ki navy ne Shukravaar ko Panama-dhwaj waale jahaaz RITI se 25 crew sadasyon ko nikaala. Business Recorder (Reuters) ke mutabik Oman ke Maritime Security Centre ne kaha ki jahaaz ko 'nishaana banaaya gaya' jisse usmein aag lag gayi; crew ko medical madad di gayi. Marine Traffic ise kachche tel ka tanker bataata hai.

Iran ke IRGC ne kaha ki Hormuz ke dakshin mein do tanker roke gaye, jo uske mutabik 'anadhikrit raaste' se, navigation system band karke aur America ki sainya madad se nikalne ki koshish kar rahe the. Ek alag bayaan mein IRGC ne daava kiya ki do million barrel tel le ja raha ek supertanker naval mine visfot ke baad ruk gaya. Iran chahta hai ki jahaaz uske tay raaste se aur uski sena ke taalmel se guzrein, aur Oman tat ke paas ke dakshini corridor ko anadhikrit maanta hai.

Greek City Times ki report ke mutabik US Central Command ka kehna hai ki mukhya shipping raaste ab Iranian mines se mukt hain, jise IRGC pravakta Hossein Mohebi ne khaarij karte hue 'swatantra saboot' maange. UKMTO ne Oman ke Khasab ke kareeb ek tanker par chhoti naav se do visphotak lagaaye jaane ki soochna di; Reuters ke sootron ne jahaaz ko Louise 1 bataaya. Kisi ne zimmedaari nahi li hai. Yuddh se pehle Hormuz se duniya ki lagbhag paanchvi hissa urja aapoorti guzarti thi.

stories.title: America mein 3 November ko midterm chunaav: aakhri polls mein Democrats aage, Trump ki approval 40% ke aaspaas; Texas-Maine jaisi Republican seaton par bhi kadi takkar
stories.summary: PBS/NPR/Marist poll mein likely voters ke beech Democrats 8 ank aage; Forbes ke poll round-up ke mutabik kai Senate muqablon mein Democratic ummeedwaar badhat mein.
body: America mein mangalvaar 3 November ko hone waale midterm chunaav se pehle PBS News/NPR/Marist ke poll mein likely voters ke beech Democrats ko 52% aur Republicans ko 44% samarthan mila. Isi poll mein President Donald Trump ke kaam ko 40% ne sahi aur 59% ne galat bataaya. Poll 19-20 October ko 1,280 registered voters par kiya gaya tha.

Forbes ke round-up ke mutabik CNN/SSRS ke polls mein Texas mein Democrat James Talarico Republican Ken Paxton se 49-43 aage hain, Maine mein Troy Jackson Senator Susan Collins se 49-45 aage hain aur Michigan mein Abdul El-Sayed Mike Rogers se 49-42 aage hain. Florida mein Republican Ashley Moody NYT/Siena poll mein 50-44 se aage hain. Fil-haal Senate mein Republicans ke paas 53-47 ka bahumat hai.

Polls sirf ek jhalak hain aur nateeje turnout par nirbhar karenge. Bharat ke liye is chunaav ka matlab America ki vyapaar, tariff aur Pashchim Asia niti par pad sakne waale asar se hai — khaaskar aise waqt mein jab Hormuz sankat se tel ke daam par dabaav bana hua hai.

editorial.title: Hormuz mein jahaaz hi nahi, sach bhi nishaane par hai
body: Ek taraf Iran har din naye tanker visfot aur 'anadhikrit' jahaazon ko rokne ke daave kar raha hai, doosri taraf America kehta hai ki raaste saaf hain. Zyadaatar ghatnaaon ki swatantra pushti nahi ho paa rahi. Aise mein shipping companiyaan aur beema bazaar sabse bure anumaan par chalte hain, aur iska bill aakhir aayaat karne waale deshon ko chukaana padta hai.

Hamari raay mein Bharat ko apne jahaazon aur naavikon ki suraksha ke liye Oman jaise padosiyon ke saath taalmel badhaana chahiye aur kootneeti mein yeh baat saaf rakhni chahiye ki samudri raaste kisi ek paksh ki marzi par nahi chal sakte. Vyaapaarik jahaazon par hamle — chahe koi bhi kare — antarrashtriya kanoon ka ullanghan hain.

stories.title: Wall Street par tech bikwaali: Nasdaq 2.86% aur S&P 500 1.82% gira; October mein Nasdaq lagbhag 5% neeche, AI kharch ki chinta phir haavi
stories.summary: Intel ke kamzor anumaan aur Amazon ke nateejon ke baad tech sheyaron mein bikwaali tez hui. Dow October mein phir bhi lagbhag 1.5% badhat ke saath band hua.
body: America ke share bazaar Shukravaar ko bhaari giraavat ke saath band hue. Yahoo Finance ke mutabik S&P 500 140.32 ank (1.82%) girkar 7,580.07 par, Dow Jones 572.25 ank (1.09%) girkar 51,770.31 par aur Nasdaq Composite 747.73 ank (2.86%) girkar 25,437.00 par band hua.

Mahine bhar ki baat karein to Dow ne October mein kareeb 1.5% ki badhat banaayi, jabki S&P 500 lagbhag 1.2% aur Nasdaq kareeb 5.2% gira — Yahoo Finance ke mutabik March 2025 ke baad Nasdaq ka sabse kamzor mahina. Bikwaali ki badi wajah Intel ka kamzor anumaan aur Amazon ke nateeje rahe; Amazon ka pichhle 12 mahine ka free cash flow $42 billion se zyada ke outflow mein raha, jisse Big Tech ke AI aur data center kharch par sawaal phir uthe.
Bharatiya bazaar Shanivaar-Ravivaar band hain, isliye Somvaar ko America ki is bikwaali, kachche tel aur Hormuz ki khabron par nivesh karne waalon ki nazar rahegi. (Yeh nivesh salaah nahi hai.)

stories.title: Bharat Electronics ka Q2 munafa 19.8% badhkar Rs 1,541 crore, aay 26.5% uchhalkar Rs 7,291 crore; order book Rs 68,717 crore
stories.summary: Raksha PSU BEL ne September timaahi mein munafe aur aay dono mein dahaai ank ki badhat dikhaayi.
body: Raksha electronics PSU Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL) ne Shukravaar ko September timaahi (Q2 FY27) ke nateeje jaari kiye. APAC News Network ki report ke body mein diye aankdon ke mutabik consolidated net munafa saal-dar-saal 19.83% badhkar Rs 1,541 crore raha, jo pichhle saal ki isi timaahi mein Rs 1,286 crore tha.

Kaaryavaahi se aay (revenue from operations) 26.49% badhkar Rs 7,291 crore ho gayi, jo ek saal pehle Rs 5,764 crore thi. 1 October 2026 tak company ki order book Rs 68,717 crore thi. Dhyaan rahe ki isi report ki headline mein alag aankde (Rs 4,720 crore aur 139%) chhape hain jo kisi aur company ke lagte hain; humne report ke vistrit body ke aankde liye hain.

editorial.title: AI ki daud ka hisaab-kitaab shuru: nivesh ki chamak ke saath nakdi ka sawaal bhi
body: October ke aakhri din Wall Street ne yaad dilaaya ki AI ke naam par bhaari kharch ko bazaar ab bina sawaal ke inaam nahi de raha. Amazon ka record cash outflow aur Intel ka kamzor anumaan alag-alag kahaaniyaan hain, lekin dono ka sandesh ek hai — nivesh ka return dikhna chahiye.

Bharat ki IT aur tech companiyon ke liye yeh mauka bhi hai aur chetaavni bhi. Global grahak AI par kharch karte rahenge, par woh utpaadakta ka saboot maangenge. Hamari raay mein Bharatiya companiyon ko 'AI-ready' ke naaron se aage badhkar thos, maapne laayak nateeje dikhaane par dhyaan dena hoga.

stories.title: Kal Hamilton ke Seddon Park mein India-New Zealand paanchva aur aakhri T20I; Eden Park ki 87 run ki haar ke baad 4-1 se series khatm karne ka iraada
stories.summary: India series 3-1 se jeet chuka hai. T20I ke baad 4 November se Eden Park mein paanch ODI ki series shuru hogi.
body: India aur New Zealand ke beech paanch match ki T20I series ka aakhri muqaabla Ravivaar, 1 November ko Hamilton ke Seddon Park mein khela jaayega. India pehle teen match jeetkar series apne naam kar chuka hai, lekin Auckland ke Eden Park mein chauthe T20I mein Glenn Phillips ke 49 gend par 107 run ki badaulat New Zealand ne use 87 run se haraaya tha.

Us match mein Jacob Duffy ne 23 run dekar 4 wicket liye the aur India 260 ke lakshya ke jawaab mein 172/9 hi bana saka tha. Aakhri match mein India ki nazar gendbaazi mein sudhaar aur series ko 4-1 par khatm karne par hogi.
Yahoo Sports ke schedule ke mutabik T20I ke baad 4 November se paanch ODI ki series shuru hogi — pehla match Eden Park, Auckland mein, phir Wellington, Hamilton aur Tauranga (do match) mein.

stories.title: Intel ke share 28% tak tute: Q4 aay ka anumaan umeed se kaafi kam, CFO bole — PC ki susti agle saal ki pehli chhamaahi tak
stories.summary: Company ne $15-16 billion ki Q4 aay ka anumaan diya, jabki analysts $17.1 billion ki ummeed kar rahe the; memory ke badhte daam se PC mehnge hone ko wajah bataaya gaya.
body: Chip banaane waali company Intel ke share Shukravaar ko bhaari giraavat mein rahe. StockTitan ke mutabik subah ke kaarobaar mein share 28% se zyada neeche the. Company ne chauthi timaahi ki aay $15.0 se $16.0 billion rehne ka anumaan diya, jabki teesri timaahi mein usne $16.5 billion ki aay dikhaayi thi aur LSEG ke mutabik analysts $17.1 billion ki ummeed kar rahe the.

Intel ne adjusted gross margin 44.1% se ghatkar 38.0% aur adjusted kamaai 25 cent prati share rehne ka anumaan diya, jabki consensus 43 cent tha. Client computing (PC) aay saal-dar-saal 5% giri, lekin data center aur AI ki aay 78% badhi. Yahoo Finance ke mutabik CEO Lip-Bu Tan ne PC mandi ko memory ke badhte daamon se jodha, jisse PC mehnge hue aur grahak peechhe hate.

CFO ne kaha ki PC bazaar ki yeh susti kam se kam agle saal ki pehli chhamaahi tak jaari rahegi. Yeh sanket Bharat samet duniya bhar ke PC aur laptop bazaar ke liye bhi ahem hai, jahaan memory ki keematon ne pehle hi daam badha diye hain.

stories.title: Ranbir Kapoor ki 'Ramayana' ki worldwide advance booking Rs 40 crore ke paar; North America se overseas pre-sales ka lagbhag 74% hissa
stories.summary: Nitesh Tiwari ki film 5 November ko duniya bhar mein release hogi; 4 November ke paid previews ki booking bhi $1 million ke kareeb.
body: Nitesh Tiwari ke nirdeshan mein bani 'Ramayana' ne release se pehle hi advance booking mein mazboot shuruaat ki hai. The Week ki report ke mutabik industry tracking data ke hisaab se film ki worldwide pre-sales lagbhag Rs 40 crore tak pahunch gayi hain. Sacnilk ke tracker ke mutabik Bharat mein pehle din ki booking Rs 15.89 crore gross (blocked seats hata kar Rs 13.07 crore) rahi, jismein NCR Rs 2.90 crore ke saath sabse aage aur Bengaluru doosre number par hai.

Overseas pre-sales lagbhag $2.58 million ki hain, jismein North America ka hissa $1.91 million yaani kareeb 74% hai. 4 November ke paid previews $1 million ke kareeb pahunch rahe hain. Report ke mutabik shuruaati trade anumaan pehle din ki worldwide kamaai ko Rs 147 crore se upar aankte hain, lekin yeh aankde anishchit hain.

Film mein Ranbir Kapoor Ram, Sai Pallavi Sita aur Yash Raavan ki bhoomika mein hain. Namit Malhotra nirmaata hain aur Yash co-producer. Film ka world premiere Los Angeles mein hua tha aur yeh Guruvaar, 5 November ko duniya bhar ke cinemaghar mein release hogi; international release Sony Pictures sambhaal raha hai.

editorial.title: Ramayana ki booking ka shor theek, par film ki asli parakh parde par hogi
body: Rs 40 crore ki worldwide pre-sales aur North America ki dhamaakedaar booking batati hai ki Bharatiya pauranik kathaon ka vaishvik bazaar ab sachmuch bada ho chuka hai. Yeh Hindi cinema ke liye achhi khabar hai, jo pichhle kuch saalon se badi hit ke liye south ki filmon ki taraf dekh raha tha.

Lekin advance booking ummeed ka paimaana hai, safalta ka nahi. Hamari raay mein itne bade bajat ki film ki asli kasauti uski kahaani, VFX ki gunvatta aur doosre hafte ki pakad hogi. Trade ke 'pehle din Rs 147 crore' jaise anumaanon ko bhi saavdhaani se dekhna chahiye — aankde release ke baad hi bolenge.
